story.headline: Inspect before sending
story.summary: The recap confirmation dialog blocked the editor while you were deciding whether to send the displayed payload. A nonblocking notification now leaves the review document usable, while sending still requires choosing Generate Recap.
story.technicalDetail:
In a development check, the review document remained usable while the sending decision stayed open. Sending still required an explicit choice.

This is an illustration of that interaction, not a test recording or a released feature. No speed or productivity improvement has been measured.
